title: Ticket Booth (compare-exchange, call_once, spinlock)

links.title: Preshing: An Introduction to Lock-Free Programming

hints: TicketBooth: `if (left > 0) --left;` is two steps even on an atomic - two buyers can both see 1. You need 'decrement only if still what I saw'.

The CAS loop: int seen = left.load(); while (seen > 0) { if (left.compare_exchange_weak(seen, seen - 1)) return true; } return false;  On failure compare_exchange writes the current value into `seen`, so the loop re-checks by itself.
Do not fetch_sub first and add back when the result is negative: remaining() can then be observed below zero.
Lazy: a std::once_flag member and std::call_once(flag, [&] { value = make(); }); in get(). Late callers block until the first one has finished.
SpinLock: one std::atomic_flag. lock: while (flag.test_and_set(std::memory_order_acquire)) {}   try_lock: return !flag.test_and_set(...);   unlock: flag.clear(std::memory_order_release);
